predecessors.name: Kingdom of Epirus
predecessors.text: Cliopatria's Molossian shape: the Molossis of Dodona and the Pogoni heartland round Ioannina

successors.name: Roman Republic
successors.text: the Molossis after the defeat: the Molossians page has 150,000 Epirotes, mostly Molossians, enslaved by decision of the Roman Senate

ledger.x: 170: the Molossians go over to Perseus against Rome.

168: the Molossian state ends with the Roman victory of the war it joined; the page does not describe a Molossian state ending in 167, and the kingdom-of-epirus dossier dates the fall of Molossia to 167 from another page.

wars.name: Third Macedonian War
wars.outcome: Perseus lost at Pydna in 168; the Molossians, on his side from 170, were defeated and, on the Molossians page, 150,000 Epirotes were enslaved; the Chaonians and Thesprotians fought for Rome (Appius Claudius's force included Thesprotian and Chaonian…

certainty.note: No page gives a Molossian frontier.
